text.name: Rare Earth Squeeze
text.rules: Record "supply squeezed". LIO chooses: Give way? If yes, SAE spends 2 points; if no, until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1, then SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: After a Chinese trawler collided with Japanese coastguard vessels near disputed islands on 7 September 2010, Japanese importers reported a halt in Chinese rare-earth shipments that lasted into late September; China denied an embargo, and later analysts have disputed how complete the halt was.
